sources.title: [2409.04702] Mel-RoFormer for Vocal Separation and Vocal Melody ...
sources.snippet: We have presented the Mel-RoFormer model, which integrates the Mel-band Projection scheme to enhance its ability to model musical signals effectively. Our experiments have shown highly promising results in vocal separation and vocal melody transcription.
